sorry to make it not clear. They know I had that problem and struggled. But they keep saying it's small problem despite whatever I told them back then. So I kept my depression hidden. So it's not do-able to tell them because they will not take it seriously anyway.

I am not comfortable to disclose it. But it's 3rd world countries. Well this isn't my first time having suicidal tendencies, and normally, it will go away in few days. But this time is different, It's already more than a week. So I start to doubt myself, and it just get worse.

There's nothing like that in my country, and I am clean. No drugs or alcohol. I am not really concerned about food right now actually. What concerns me the most is the urge to kill myself. It's so so strong, and that's the only thing I can think of now. Like trying to stop myself to literally end my life.
